title: Product Owner
description:
#ThriveatMMDSmart

 Would you like to build a career in a leading multinational IT company?

 We are seeking a Product Owner to join our growing product team. 

You’ll collaborate closely with technical teams, product designers, and stakeholders, taking ownership of product functionality from concept to launch and ongoing optimization. This is a hands-on position where you will play a key role in translating business needs into actionable solutions that support scalability and efficiency.

 Since 2007, MMDSmart has been a leading supplier in cloud communications, delivering game-changing IT products to businesses in over 100 countries. Our success is fueled by the inspiration and innovative ideas of our team members, encouraging their growth and impacting our Messaging and Voice solutions. These empower our clients to communicate more effectively with their customers. Don’t miss this chance to  excel in a rapidly expanding tech company, where your potential and ambitions are not just recognized, but celebrated.

What will you do at MMDSmart?

 Drive all processes related to product definition, development, and launch.
 Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to align on the product vision and core functionalities, and ensure they are communicated throughout the product development lifecycle.
 Work with internal and stakeholders to define product features based on customer needs, provide regular progress updates, and present outcomes.
 Manage the product backlog: break down high-level features into user stories and tasks, define clear acceptance criteria, and prioritize effectively.
 Support development teams during iterations by clarifying requirements and adjusting priorities to maximize business value.
 Monitor product progress at every stage and proactively identify and mitigate risks.

You are a perfect match if you have:
 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product/Project Manager, or Business Analyst in an Agile environment.
 Experience in B2B product management (CRM, BSS, OMS) is a strong advantage.
 Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Agile methodologies.
 Technically proficient: able to grasp high-level architecture and technical concepts.
 Previous experience in a software development company, ideally with a focus on web applications.
 Upper-intermediate or higher level of English (spoken and written).
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 Excellent communication and presentation skills.

What you need to succeed:

 Analytical person who can control the details but still see the full picture;
 Organized and formal so that communication will always be clear, and everyone are harnessed;
 Learning and continuous improvement in nature;
 Excellent communication and presentation skills (grouped into soft skills for effective stakeholder engagement, as well as technical skills, such as data-driven decision-making);
 Diplomatic and pragmatic - works with many stakeholders and drives for the optimal result;
 Planning and visualization skills.
